working_features: REPL loop accepting commands, with quit/exit support
Random password generation with configurable length (default 16)
Length command to set password length
Toggle commands for uppercase, lowercase, digits, symbols with on/off/toggle syntax
Password generation uses only currently enabled character sets
Strength rating displayed for each generated password (weak, medium, strong, very strong)
Generate N command to produce multiple passwords
Config command displays current settings
Error message when all character sets are disabled, refusing generation
Ambiguous character exclusion toggle, filtering 0/O/1/l/I
Passphrase generation with passphrase command, including configurable word count and delimiter
Passphrase strength rating based on entropy
